run_cpufreq_monitor: run a CPUFreq monitor thread to collect CPU frequency data at a given interval
collect_cpu_frequency: collect the current CPU frequency in MHz for all CPUs in the process affinity mask
create_cpufreq_instance: create a CPUFreq monitor instance with a collection interval and job UUID for tracking
terminate_cpufreq_collector: terminate the CPUFreq collector thread and join it to stop frequency monitoring
check_cpufreq_support: check if the system supports CPU frequency monitoring via sysfs cpuinfo_cur_freq
